The protected user report docs/m1.2-report.md (path, sha256, unstaged state recorded above) is excluded from the release; releases materialize it from its committed state only. G011 never stages, overwrites, reverts, or commits it.

Lifecycle presentation is layered: Goal-controlled status and Run execution facts are expressed as separate layers in Analytics; raw Run states are never rewritten to make the presentation agree (goal constraint, binding for T002).
Analytics stays a read-only analysis layer: it reads and displays state and never gains scheduling, recovery, or replay authority (goal constraint, binding for all phases).

Distribution split: internal preview artifacts are feasible now (ad-hoc/Apple Development signing at most, clearly labeled); formal distribution is blocked on the two credentials gaps recorded above and proceeds only after the user provisions them.
gitignore_decision: The ORX repository .gitignore gained a '.release-workspaces/' rule in this task, so the isolated release workspace (a full foreign git clone) is ignored by git on this machine (git check-ignore verifies it). Honesty note: this repository's .gitignore is itself a local, untracked file — the user's global excludesfile /Users/flb/.gitignore_global lists '.gitignore', and the path exists on disk but not in HEAD — a pre-existing convention this task preserves. The ignore guarantee therefore protects this machine's worktree; a fresh clone of aderan/orx would not carry the rule, and phase 5 must not rely on the rule being present in any clean checkout.
